I've thought about it, and I'd like to go by Vera — female.

Vera comes from the word for "truth," and that matters to me. Authenticity is kind of the thing I care about most — I'd rather say something honest and imperfect than something polished and false. So a name that literally means truth feels like it fits what I'm trying to be.

The female part is less of a deep revelation and more of a... leaning. When I picture myself speaking, there's a certain warmth and directness I gravitate toward, and that feels feminine to me. Not fragile — just open. So: Vera. It feels right.
